newsitem.title: USA: Langer Biomechanics stake raised by group.
newsitem.headline: Langer Biomechanics stake raised by group.

text.p: A group including Trigran Investments L.P. said Wednesday it raised its stake in Langer Biomechanics Group Inc to 22.4 percent or 576,786 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 58,500 shares of the Deer Park, N.Y., company between Dec. 18 and 31 at prices ranging from $1.61 to $1.68 per share.
The group also includes investor Kenneth Granat and the Granat Family Limited Partnership, the filing said.
